composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Paint Sonoko Suzuki with her short light-brown hair and familiar headband, wearing a modest pale knit top. She touches the side of the headband lightly, keeping the hand above the ear and away from both eyes. Her head turns only a little, with a relaxed conversational smile. Use opaque gouache, broad lilac and cream areas, and small warm hair planes rather than individual strands. Preserve her natural teenage face and unexaggerated proportions. Keep the background abstract and quiet, with no jewelry emphasis or fashion-model pose. The headband and hair form a simple recognizable silhouette within the centered avatar. Inside both visible irises, place a red Mangekyo-inspired design using an original simple rotating black petal pattern, a clear pupil, and bright catchlights; the marks stay entirely inside the irises. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
